overall_notes: The paper presents a novel dialogue generation model using semantic latent space regression as alternative to MLE training. Human evaluation was properly conducted with crowdsourced workers. Automatic metrics were used but acknowledged as secondary to human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some internal implementation details that don't belong in the model comparison list.
